content: {"paper_id":"W2112548098","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"This paper models dynamic ensemble pruning as a multi-label classification task, by considering the members of the ensemble as labels.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确将动态集成剪枝建模为多标签分类任务，把集成成员视为可同时成立的多个标签，满足多标记学习定义。"},{"keyword_id":"classifier-ensemble","exact_quote":"Dynamic (also known as instance-based) ensemble pruning selects a (potentially) different subset of models from an ensemble during prediction based on the given unknown instance with the goal of maximizing prediction accuracy.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文研究按未知样本动态选择集成中模型子集以提升预测，属于结合多个分类器预测/按样本分配专家的分类器集成范畴。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
